body.name: Deterministic GCM scaling and action problem
body.construction:
For a continuous perturbation \(h\) for which the origin-constrained and unrestricted GCM energies are well defined, let \(\Phi(h)\) be the origin-constrained likelihood-ratio energy generated by \(t^2+h(t)\). For absolutely continuous \(h\) with \(h(0)=0\) and \(h'\in L^2(\mathbb R)\), define
\[
 I_\star=\inf\left\{\frac12\int_{\mathbb R}\{h'(t)\}^2dt:\Phi(h)\ge1\right\}.
\]
These are deterministic scaling and action objects; they do not define a probability-tail rate, a Palm intensity, or an extreme-value centering.
